name: pagination
description: Links to the pages of a long list, each a square target, the current one filled, shrinking to Previous, the current page, and Next when it is narrow.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: The pagination's own width below which only Previous, the current page, and Next remain.

attributes.name: data-variant
attributes.description: The hue of the current page and of the hover tint.

attributes.name: data-justify
attributes.description: Where the links sit in the row.

children.description: The links, in page order, with role="list".
A page link, or a span holding an ellipsis for skipped pages.

a11y.notes: Put aria-label="Pagination" on the nav. The current page's link carries aria-current="page". Previous and Next carry rel="prev" and rel="next" and visible text or an aria-label; they are what remains when the row is narrow. Skipped pages are a span, not a link. Put role="list" on the ol.
